output.reason: The setpoint error in the Tallis master file explains the Meridane-only failures, with K1 as the control (booked before Tallis) and K3 packed with the old fungicide, and it comes with clear, urgent fixes; the one weak spot is that the Lower Serra effect is only partly ruled out.
